name: se-primer
description: YZM301 Yazılım Gerçekleme ve Test — SE Primer v2: Yazılım Mühendisliği, Oynanan Bir Kitap

scripts.test: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const r = spawnSync('npx', ['cypress', 'run'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(r.status || 0);"
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const r = spawnSync('npx', ['cypress', 'run', '--spec', 'cypress/e2e/se_primer.cy.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(r.status || 0);"
scripts.test:parity: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const r = spawnSync('npx', ['cypress', 'run', '--spec', 'cypress/e2e/se_primer_parity.cy.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(r.status || 0);"
scripts.test:all: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); console.log('1. Python Oracle Çalıştırılıyor...'); const py = spawnSync('python', ['tests/parite.py'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); if (py.status !== 0) process.exit(py.status || 1); console.log('2. Cypress E2E ve Parite Testleri Çalıştırılıyor...'); delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const cy = spawnSync('npx', ['cypress', 'run'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(cy.status || 0);"
scripts.cypress:open: node -e "delete process.env.ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE; const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const r = spawnSync('npx', ['cypress', 'open'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.exit(r.status || 0);"
